svg.title: treehill: quality-budget curves for ParetoGS and Independent GNS

cc:Work.dc:title: treehill: quality-budget curves for ParetoGS and Independent GNS
cc:Work.dc:description: Measured paper points, actual Gaussian count as a percentage of Full (0.1%-50%, log scale). No smoothing or fitting. FlexGS is omitted only from the web figure.
